component.name: Twigpad
component.summary: Tree notes editor that opens TreePad .hjt files

description.p: Twigpad is a fast, free tree notes editor and outliner for Linux. Your notes sit in a tree on the left and the text of the selected note on the right: the classic two-pane notepad layout. Nest notes as deep as you like, move whole branches around and search everything at once. It works offline, needs no account and keeps a whole notebook in one file.

Coming from TreePad Lite? Twigpad opens and saves .hjt files directly, with no Wine and no converting. Your tree, titles, text and links between notes come across as they are, the familiar keys work (Ins, Shift+Ins, Shift+arrows, F2, Ctrl+H), and the files you save still open on Windows. Backup copies, zipped backups and damaged .hjt files open too.

ul.li: Unlimited nesting: add, move, sort, drag, cut, copy and paste whole branches
Find and replace across every note title and text at once
Formatted notes with headings, lists, colours, tables and pictures
Spell check, with dictionaries for 50 languages a click away
Undo for the tree, a backup copy on save, auto-save and crash recovery
Import text and CSV files, export to text or HTML, and print
Focus on one branch, or open branches in tabs
Light and dark themes, a system tray icon and a portable mode
In English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Japanese

description.p: Use it as a personal knowledge base or wiki, for meeting and project notes, research and writing outlines, a journal, recipes, code snippets or as a personal information manager.
Twigpad is free software (GPL-3.0-or-later). It is an independent project and is not affiliated with TreePad or its makers.
